title: Sprunki Pyramixed
slogan: Explore the unique universe of Sprunki Pyramixed!
description: Play Sprunki Pyramixed (also known as Sprunki Pyramix, Pyramixed Sprunki) on Cocrea - Create amazing music mixes, explore unique characters, and join our creative community. Official home of Sprunki Pyramixed mod and mixes.

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Sprunki Pyramixed: A New Musical Journey
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: [highlight]Sprunki Pyramixed[/highlight] is a groundbreaking rhythm-based music creation game that revolutionizes the way players interact with music and gameplay. Set in a vibrant, geometric world inspired by pyramid shapes, players take control of the iconic character Sprunki as they navigate through mesmerizing musical landscapes. The game seamlessly blends elements of rhythm gaming with creative music mixing, allowing players to craft their own unique soundscapes while progressing through increasingly challenging levels.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Start Your Musical Journey: Launch the game and enter the vibrant world of Sprunki Pyramixed. Choose your character and get ready to create!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Master the Basics: Learn the intuitive controls - tap to the beat, drag elements to mix sounds, and combine different musical patterns.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Create Your Mix: Experiment with various sound samples, effects, and rhythms. Layer different beats and melodies to craft your unique track.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep4: Progress and Unlock: Complete challenges to unlock new characters, sounds, and special effects. Each level brings new musical possibilities.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep5: Share and Compete: Save your best mixes, share them with the community, and challenge others to beat your high scores!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Create stunning music mixes with our revolutionary rhythm-based system. Blend beats, melodies, and effects in real-time while your character moves through the geometric world.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Experience an ever-changing musical journey where your actions shape the soundtrack. Each level features unique sound combinations and challenging rhythm patterns.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Access a vast collection of musical elements, including electronic beats, orchestral sounds, and special effects. New content updates regularly expand your creative possibilities.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Play seamlessly across devices - start creating on your mobile and continue on desktop. Your progress and creations sync automatically.
HomeFeatures.feature5Description: Share your musical creations, collaborate with other players, and participate in community challenges. Vote for your favorite mixes and gain inspiration from top creators.
HomeFeatures.feature6Description: Jump right in with intuitive controls and helpful tutorials. Whether you're a music pro or complete beginner, Sprunki Pyramixed welcomes all skill levels.

CharacterPage.title: Sprunki Pyramixed Characters
CharacterPage.description: Meet our diverse cast of musical characters!
CharacterPage.desc_p: Sprunki Pyramixed is a creative and rhythm-filled game where players can mix and match different characters to create their own unique musical masterpieces. Each character not only has a distinct look but also represents different sound elements, enriching the player's music-making experience.

cardlist.title: Mr. Sun
cardlist.desc: A sun with a happy face symbolizing optimism. Brings cheerful, uplifting melodies, adding positive energy to any track.

cardlist.title: Durple (Sprunki Purple)
cardlist.desc: A purple dragon embodying mystery and charm. Offers rich, soulful melodies, adding depth and emotion to your work.

cardlist.title: Mr. Tree
cardlist.desc: A bright green tree with a joyful expression. Mimics organ or church bell sounds, perfect for light, cheerful melodies.

cardlist.title: Simon (Sprunki Yellow)
cardlist.desc: Yellow design symbolizing happiness and energy. Brings bright, catchy melodies, making your track unforgettable.

cardlist.title: Tunner (Sprunki Brown)
cardlist.desc: Brownish design, evoking warmth and coziness. Provides gentle, comforting melodies, perfect for a warm atmosphere.

cardlist.title: Mr. Fun Computer
cardlist.desc: A cute robot with a futuristic voice. His mechanical voice is ideal for dynamic and creative works.

cardlist.title: Wenda (Sprunki White)
cardlist.desc: A white cat with long ears and a cute expression. Her angelic voice adds elegance to your music.

cardlist.title: Pinki (Sprunki Pink)
cardlist.desc: A pink bunny representing innocence and energy. Sweet, playful voice perfect for fun, light-hearted tracks.

cardlist.title: Jevin (Sprunki Blue)
cardlist.desc: Deep blue design exuding coolness and charm. Smooth, deep voice adds a cool, confident vibe to your track.

cardlist.title: Black (Sprunki Black)
cardlist.desc: Pitch-black appearance radiating mystery and authority. Strong, powerful voice perfect for mysterious or tense tracks.

cardlist.title: Oren (Sprunki Orange)
cardlist.desc: Bright orange color reflecting his upbeat personality. Brings vibrant electronic beats and dynamic sound effects.

cardlist.title: Raddy (Sprunki Red)
cardlist.desc: Red skin symbolizing strength and energy. Delivers powerful drum beats, adding intensity and strength to any track.

cardlist.title: Clukr (Sprunki Silver)
cardlist.desc: Silver appearance with mechanical elements. Provides cutting-edge mechanical beats, ideal for sci-fi or tech-inspired tracks.

cardlist.title: Fun Bot
cardlist.desc: Bright blue eyes and a cute tech-inspired style. Injects playful robot rhythms with quirky beats and sound effects.

cardlist.title: Vineria (Sprunki Green)
cardlist.desc: Green skin and vine-like hair, embodying nature's beauty. Adds light, airy sound effects, perfect for creating peaceful atmospheres.

cardlist.title: Gray
cardlist.desc: Gray appearance with dark gray eyes. Provides resonating echo sounds, creating a vast, expansive feeling.

cardlist.title: Brud (Sprunki Brown)
cardlist.desc: Wears a barrel on his head, adding a humorous twist. Offers quirky and playful sounds, perfect for unexpected transitions.

cardlist.title: Garnold (Sprunki Yellow)
cardlist.desc: Eyes covered by an electronic screen. Delivers strong, intense beats, ideal for energetic music.

cardlist.title: QWAKCX (Sprunki Lime)
cardlist.desc: Quirky green design for experimental styles. Known for avant-garde design and sound effects, encouraging musical exploration.

cardlist.title: Sky (Sprunki Sky Blue)
cardlist.desc: Blue-toned design symbolizing freedom. Adds light, ethereal effects, ideal for dreamy music.
